<translate>
<!--T:3-->
The '''Classic Saga''' is the first saga of the [[Special:MyLanguage/Sagas|story mode]] and is available from the start. It follows Kid Goku's adventures, from his first Dragon Ball hunt to Piccolo Jr. at the 23rd World Martial Arts Tournament: the Red Ribbon Army, Fortuneteller Baba's fighters, King Piccolo and three tournaments. All 52 quests take place on [[Special:MyLanguage/Earth|Earth]].
</translate>

<translate>
<!--T:4-->
Completing every quest of the Classic Saga opens the [[Special:MyLanguage/Saiyan Saga|Saiyan Saga]].
</translate>

<translate>

<translate>
== Notes == <!--T:183-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:184-->
* Tournament fights take place in Plains biomes.
* Quest 19, ''The Sacred Water'', rewards the [[Special:MyLanguage/Sacred Water|Sacred Water]]: drinking it permanently multiplies all your stats by ×1.1, once per character. The three [[Special:MyLanguage/Capsules|capsules]] from the same quest each permanently raise one stat.
* Several quests send you to [[Special:MyLanguage/Masters|masters]]: [[Special:MyLanguage/Master Roshi|Master Roshi]] (quests 6, 7 and 30), [[Special:MyLanguage/Korin|Korin]] (quest 19), [[Special:MyLanguage/Fortuneteller Baba|Fortuneteller Baba]] (quest 23) and [[Special:MyLanguage/Goku|Goku]] (quest 52).
* Fortuneteller Baba, whose fighters you face in quests 24 to 29, also hosts [[Special:MyLanguage/Fortuneteller Baba's Tournament|Fortuneteller Baba's Tournament]].
</translate>
